events.label: Renault Founded
events.fact: Louis Renault and brothers founded the French automaker in Billancourt.

events.label: Ford Motor Company Founded
events.fact: Henry Ford launched the company that later introduced the Model T.

events.label: Wall Street Crash of 1929
events.fact: Major stock market collapse signaling the onset of the Great Depression.

events.label: Toyota Motor Corporation Founded
events.fact: Spun off from Toyoda Automatic Loom Works in Japan.

events.label: Hyundai Motor Company Founded
events.fact: Founded in South Korea, later expanding into a global automaker.

events.label: Microsoft Founded
events.fact: Bill Gates and Paul Allen founded the software company in Albuquerque.

events.label: Amazon Founded
events.fact: Launched by Jeff Bezos as an online bookstore in Washington state.

events.label: Lehman Brothers Bankruptcy
events.fact: Peak crisis event of the global financial crash and Great Recession.

events.label: COVID-19 Market Crash
events.fact: Rapid global equity sell-off in early 2020 as pandemic lockdowns began.
